bio: This venerable townhouse enjoys a fantastic location in the heart of Zurich – the small terrace is a lovely spot in the summer. With its elegant contemporary decor, the interior is also inviting, and the charming hostess provides attentive service. Prepared using select ingredients, the dishes draw on Mediterranean and Asian influences. Options on the menu range from veal cordon bleu with truffle Brie to tuna with sesame and a ginger and mango sauce. Shorter, simpler menu at lunchtime....
